text: (1) Equal to high school qualification in China or above;(2) Full transcripts of final education, original or notarized version, in notarized Chinese or English Translation.(3) A scanned copy of score reports of the HSK tests. Applicants should hold an HSK (Level 5) certificate with a minimum score of 180. Those who apply for a bachelor's degree in Chinese Language should obtain an HSK (Level 4) certificate with a minimum score of 180. Admitted students are required to submit original copies of those official documents for verification. Those who provide fake materials will be disqualified from admission.(4) An undergraduate study plan, including applicants' understanding of the discipline or major they are applying for and their plan, about 400 words.(5) A scanned copy of passport valid for more than 6 months.(6) A scanned copy of passport including the photo page, and all pages with visa records, and entry and exit stamps (if any).(7) Single person color photo without a hat, taken recently within the last 6 months (same size as the one on the passport).(8) Other requirements★ Applicants are required to submit additional materials if necessary.★Documents that can prove applicants' comprehensive abilities, such as certificates of awards, certificates, admission letters from foreign universities and so on, can be submitted together with their application.★ Application materials will NOT be returned regardless of the application result.
